roles.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
roles.description: Popularized by companies like Palantir and enterprise AI firms. You are an elite hybrid of Software Engineer and Technical Solution Architect deployed directly to key clients to design, customize, and integrate enterprise AI and data platforms in mission-critical environments.
responsibilities: Work directly on-site/remotely with enterprise clients to scope and build production systems
Build custom connectors, ETL pipelines, and API integrations into client infrastructures
Rapidly prototype full-stack solutions and translate ambiguous business needs into scalable code
Collaborate with internal core product teams to feed client requirements back into the product
Lead technical client demonstrations, onboarding, and deployment escalations
qualifications: B.Tech CSE with high adaptability and client-facing communication skills
Solid full-stack or backend engineering foundation (Python, Java, TypeScript)
Deep familiarity with cloud architecture, APIs, and enterprise data warehouses
High degree of problem ownership and rapid prototyping ability
growth_path: Head of Solutions / VP Customer Engineering

roles.title: AI Agent & Systems Engineer
roles.description: Build autonomous, tool-using AI agents that plan, reason, and take action in complex software ecosystems. You go beyond prompt wrappers to build reliable agentic loops, MCP servers, and multi-agent coordination frameworks.
responsibilities: Architect multi-agent systems using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen
Design function calling, tool use, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations
Implement memory architectures, state management, and loop error-recovery protocols
Evaluate agent reliability, cost, latency, and guardrails with automated test suites
Integrate agentic workflows into existing backend microservices and databases
qualifications: B.Tech CSE with strong software engineering fundamentals
High proficiency in Python and asynchronous programming (asyncio)
Deep understanding of LLM capabilities, token limits, and function calling
Knowledge of distributed systems, vector databases, and API protocols

roles.title: Software Developer (Backend)
roles.description: Build and maintain the server-side logic, databases, and APIs that power web and mobile applications. You are the resilient engine behind every digital product.
responsibilities: Design and develop high-throughput RESTful & gRPC APIs
Architect and optimize relational and document databases
Write clean, scalable, multi-threaded, and test-covered code
Implement caching layers, rate limiting, and auth protocols
Deploy and monitor microservices on cloud platforms
qualifications: B.Tech CSE or related degree
Strong DSA and problem-solving skills
Proficiency in at least one backend language (Java, Python, Go, Node.js)
Knowledge of databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis)

must_have: Java or Python or Go or Node.js
good_to_have: Spring Boot or Django or Express

roles.title: Software Developer (Frontend)
roles.description: Build high-performance, accessible, and responsive user interfaces that delight millions. You turn complex design systems into smooth browser interactions.
responsibilities: Develop interactive web UIs using React, Next.js, or Vue
Manage complex client-side state, caching, and optimistic UI updates
Optimize web vital metrics (LCP, FID, CLS, Core Web Vitals)
Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers and design systems
Ensure accessibility (a11y) and cross-browser resilience
qualifications: B.Tech CSE or related degree
Deep mastery of JavaScript (ES6+) and modern TypeScript
Hands-on experience with modern component libraries and state managers
Understanding of browser rendering pipelines and HTTP performance

roles.title: Full Stack Developer
roles.description: Own feature development end-to-end from user-facing components down to schema design and cloud deployment. Highest hiring demand across startups and product companies.
responsibilities: Architect and ship full features across UI, business logic, and databases
Develop scalable APIs and connect them to responsive frontend applications
Provision cloud services, CI/CD pipelines, and monitor production uptime
Collaborate directly with founders, product managers, and designers
Maintain code hygiene, unit tests, and performance profiles
qualifications: B.Tech CSE or equivalent
Proficiency in frontend (React/Next) and backend (Node/Spring/Django)
Solid database design experience across SQL and NoSQL
Comfortable with containerization and cloud hosting

roles.title: Platform & Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
roles.description: Treat operations as a software problem. SREs and Platform Engineers build internal developer platforms, ensure 99.99% availability, and orchestrate automated self-healing cloud clusters.
responsibilities: Define and enforce Service Level Objectives (SLOs, SLIs, SLAs) and error budgets
Design and maintain large-scale Kubernetes clusters and infrastructure as code (Terraform)
Build internal developer platforms (IDPs) to allow software teams to ship autonomously
Lead incident post-mortems, root cause analysis, and chaos engineering drills
Implement end-to-end observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Datadog)
qualifications: B.Tech CSE with strong Linux systems and networking core
Proficiency in Go, Python, or Rust for systems tooling
Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and distributed networking
Production debugging mindset under high-stress incident scenarios

roles.title: Data Platform & Analytics Engineer
roles.description: Construct scalable data highways. You ingest petabytes of streaming and batch data, transform it with dbt and Spark, and supply reliable data to AI models and business analysts.
responsibilities: Build and orchestrate fault-tolerant ETL/ELT pipelines using Airflow or Prefect
Design cloud data warehouses and lakes (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks)
Implement data modeling frameworks and transformation layers using dbt
Optimize distributed queries on PySpark and Apache Iceberg/Delta Lake
Enforce data governance, quality testing, and schema validation
qualifications: B.Tech CSE with strong SQL and Python expertise
Understanding of distributed data processing concepts
Familiarity with cloud data warehouse ecosystems
Knowledge of database indexing, partitioning, and columnar storage

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Bridge the divide between research science and production engineering. You train, evaluate, containerize, and serve ML models handling millions of live user predictions.
responsibilities: Build automated ML training, validation, and inference pipelines
Deploy models as low-latency microservices with FastAPI and Triton/TorchServe
Monitor live model drift, concept drift, latency, and throughput
Optimize models via quantization, pruning, and ONNX conversion
Collaborate with data teams to engineer robust feature stores
qualifications: B.Tech CSE with solid grounding in calculus, linear algebra, and CS fundamentals
Proficiency in PyTorch or TensorFlow and Scikit-learn
Software engineering capabilities in API design, Docker, and CI/CD
Understanding of production MLOps lifecycles

good_to_have: AWS SageMaker or GCP Vertex AI

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.description: Formulate mathematical hypotheses and uncover causal patterns from raw enterprise data. You translate vague commercial questions into predictive intelligence and strategic impact.
responsibilities: Conduct thorough exploratory data analysis (EDA) and hypothesis testing
Design robust A/B tests, experimentation frameworks, and causal inference studies
Train predictive models for churn, customer lifetime value, and recommendation engines
Synthesize complex statistical findings into actionable executive roadmaps
Collaborate with product teams to build metrics and decision frameworks
qualifications: B.Tech CSE / Math / Statistics with keen analytical curiosity
Proficiency in Python (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Statsmodels)
Strong foundation in probability, regression, and inferential statistics
Excellent storytelling and data visualization abilities

roles.title: Business Intelligence & Data Analyst
roles.description: Democratize data clarity across organizations. You build executive KPI dashboards, author critical SQL queries, and present data-backed narratives that steer revenue decisions.
responsibilities: Query relational and lakehouse databases to extract metrics and anomalies
Design real-time interactive business dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or Looker
Partner with cross-functional leaders to define conversion funnels and retention rates
Automate recurring reporting schedules using Python scripts and scheduled queries
Conduct ad-hoc diagnostic deep-dives into operational bottlenecks
qualifications: B.Tech CSE or analytical degree with rigorous attention to detail
High fluency in SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions)
Proficiency in leading BI platforms and spreadsheet modeling
Clear verbal and written business presentation skills

roles.title: Cloud Solutions Engineer
roles.description: Architect and govern enterprise cloud estates on AWS, GCP, or Azure. You ensure systems scale smoothly, safeguard data boundaries, and optimize multi-million dollar cloud budgets.
responsibilities: Design, provision, and maintain resilient cloud infrastructure architectures
Implement IAM security postures, zero-trust controls, and network firewalls
Automate environment provisioning with Terraform and CloudFormation
Analyze workload utilization to implement FinOps cloud cost optimizations
Support application migrations from on-premise servers to cloud native stacks
qualifications: B.Tech CSE with firm grasp of IP networking and operating systems
Cloud certification (AWS Solutions Architect / GCP Cloud Engineer preferred)
Scripting literacy in Python or Bash
Understanding of cloud security and IAM fundamentals

must_have: AWS or GCP or Azure Core Services

roles.title: Cybersecurity & SOC Analyst
roles.description: Defend national and enterprise digital sovereignty. You monitor SIEM telemetry 24/7, triage malicious vectors, patch zero-day exploits, and harden attack surfaces.
responsibilities: Monitor networks and endpoints for security incidents using SIEM platforms
Conduct systematic vulnerability scans, patch management, and pen tests
Triage security alerts, contain ransomware threats, and lead incident response
Audit source code and infrastructure against OWASP and NIST guidelines
Conduct phishing simulations and enforce corporate cybersecurity hygiene
qualifications: B.Tech CSE with deep passion for systems security and ethical hacking
Exemplary understanding of TCP/IP, operating systems, and cryptography
Certifications give huge advantage (CompTIA Security+, CEH, eJPT)
Analytical forensic reasoning and investigative curiosity

roles.title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
roles.description: Determine what gets built, why, and in what sequence. APMs combine technical feasibility, user empathy, and business ROI to drive features from whiteboard to launch.
responsibilities: Conduct user research, synthesize customer pain points, and write detailed PRDs
Define success metrics, OKRs, and north star indicators for product features
Work collaboratively with engineering, design, marketing, and legal teams
Run continuous sprint prioritization rituals and maintain clean product backlogs
Analyze experimentation data and A/B test funnels to refine user journeys
qualifications: B.Tech CSE provides high competitive edge (technical credibility with engineers)
Exceptional written and oral persuasion and storytelling skills
Product sense, first-principles thinking, and data literacy
Demonstrated leadership in college initiatives, hackathons, or internships
growth_path: VP of Product / Chief Product Officer

roles.title: Business Analyst / Tech Consultant
roles.description: Translate complex commercial dilemmas into high-impact technology architectures. You serve as the authoritative bridge between corporate clients and software delivery teams.
responsibilities: Elicit and document client workflows, system requirements, and user stories
Build process flow diagrams, BPMN maps, and solution architecture proposals
Analyze operational metrics and financial models to justify technology modernization
Coordinate UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and stakeholder sign-offs
Present executive briefings to enterprise business leaders
qualifications: B.Tech CSE gives strong edge in techno-commercial consulting
Structured problem-solving and presentation prowess
Strong SQL and data analysis literacy
Familiarity with corporate IT systems and software lifecycles

roles.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
roles.description: Engineers who build software to test software. SDETs author high-concurrency automated test harnesses, performance testing suites, and CI/CD quality gates.
responsibilities: Design scalable automation frameworks from scratch using Java, Python, or TypeScript
Automate REST API testing, contract verification, and end-to-end UI journeys
Conduct performance, stress, and load testing using JMeter or k6
Integrate automated test runs into CI/CD release pipelines
Debug root-cause code defects alongside core software developers
qualifications: B.Tech CSE with strong object-oriented coding discipline
Proficiency in Java or Python or TypeScript
Deep familiarity with testing methodologies, mocking, and assertions
Knowledge of CI/CD integration and containerized test runs

roles.title: Mobile App Developer (Android / iOS)
roles.description: India runs on mobile — UPI payments, quick commerce, ed-tech and OTT all reach hundreds of millions of devices. You build those apps: native or cross-platform, obsessed with frame rates, battery drain, offline behaviour and store release cycles.
responsibilities: Build and ship features across the app lifecycle: screens, navigation, state and offline caching
Integrate REST/GraphQL APIs, push notifications, payments and device hardware (camera, GPS, biometrics)
Profile and fix jank, memory leaks and battery drain on low-end Android devices
Write unit and UI/widget tests, and automate builds with Gradle, Fastlane or Xcode CI
Own releases: store review guidelines, staged rollouts and crash triage
qualifications: B.Tech CSE or equivalent with strong OOP and data-structure fundamentals
One shipped app or a portfolio of projects is the strongest possible signal
Kotlin/Swift fundamentals, or React Native / Flutter for cross-platform roles
Patience for device-specific and OS-version-specific bugs

good_to_have: Play Store / App Store release process

roles.title: Game Developer (Unity / Unreal)
roles.description: India's gaming, esports and VFX market is scaling fast, and studios now hire engine-literate engineers rather than only artists. You write the gameplay systems, physics, AI behaviour and rendering paths that make a game feel good at 60 FPS on a mid-range phone.
responsibilities: Build gameplay systems: player controllers, combat, inventory, level logic and UI in Unity (C#) or Unreal (C++/Blueprints)
Optimise rendering, physics and memory to hold frame-rate budgets on mobile and console targets
Implement game AI (pathfinding, state machines, behaviour trees) and networked multiplayer state sync
Build editor and pipeline tooling so designers can iterate without engineering help
Run playtests, instrument telemetry and tune difficulty and retention curves
qualifications: B.Tech CSE / BCA with strong maths (linear algebra, vectors, trigonometry)
A finished, playable game in your portfolio — a game-jam entry beats any certificate
Solid programming fundamentals in C# or C++, including memory and pointers
Genuine curiosity about how engines work under the hood

roles.title: Embedded Systems & IoT Engineer
roles.description: Every EV, drone, set-top box and payment terminal in India is a computer with no screen attached. You write firmware that talks to sensors and actuators over I2C/SPI/UART/CAN, and make it survive brownouts, heat and a decade of continuous operation.
responsibilities: Write bare-metal and RTOS firmware in C/C++ for microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, ARM Cortex)
Bring up peripherals and interfaces: I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, BLE and Wi-Fi stacks
Read datasheets and schematics, and debug with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and JTAG probes
Implement power management, watchdog and failsafe behaviour for long-running field devices
Build hardware-in-the-loop test rigs and CI that flashes firmware onto real boards
qualifications: B.Tech in ECE / EEE / CSE with comfort across hardware and software
Strong C, bit manipulation and interrupt-driven thinking
A microcontroller project you actually soldered and debugged yourself
Patience for problems that reproduce on one board in a hundred

roles.title: Analytics Engineer
roles.description: The layer between raw data and dashboards. You model warehouse tables in dbt and SQL, encode each business definition once, and give analysts trustworthy, documented, tested data instead of forty copies of the same query.
responsibilities: Model raw source tables into clean, documented warehouse marts (staging → intermediate → mart)
Write and review SQL and dbt models with tests, freshness checks and lineage documentation
Own metric definitions so "active user" means the same thing in every dashboard
Partner with analysts and product teams to turn recurring questions into reusable data models
Keep warehouse cost and query performance healthy with partitioning and incremental models
qualifications: B.Tech / B.Sc / B.Com with strong SQL and data-modelling fundamentals
Understanding of dimensional modelling (star schema, slowly changing dimensions)
Exposure to dbt, Airflow or comparable pipeline tooling
Ability to read a requirement and design the table that answers it

roles.title: Product Analyst
roles.description: Part analyst, part product manager. You instrument funnels, run A/B tests, and answer why the feature that shipped last week did or did not move retention — then argue for what should happen next.
responsibilities: Define and instrument product events and funnels alongside the engineering team
Design, size and read A/B experiments with statistical honesty
Build self-serve dashboards for PMs and leadership — and retire the ones nobody opens
Run cohort, retention and funnel analyses to find exactly where users drop off
Translate findings into product recommendations with a clear expected impact
qualifications: B.Tech / BBA / B.Sc with strong quantitative reasoning
SQL fluency plus Excel or Sheets modelling; Python or R is a bonus
Working knowledge of probability and hypothesis testing
Ability to explain a number's business meaning in one sentence

roles.title: NLP & Conversational AI Engineer
roles.description: Language is the interface now: support bots, voice assistants, resume parsers, Indic-language translation. You build the retrieval, embedding, fine-tuning and evaluation pipelines that make models useful on messy real-world text.
responsibilities: Build NLP pipelines: tokenisation, embeddings, retrieval, classification, summarisation and translation
Fine-tune or prompt models (BERT-family, open LLMs, hosted APIs) and evaluate them rigorously
Build retrieval-augmented generation over company documents with vector search and re-ranking
Handle Indic languages, code-mixed text and domain jargon that off-the-shelf models get wrong
Ship models as services with latency, cost and quality monitoring
qualifications: B.Tech / M.Tech with ML fundamentals: probability, linear algebra, optimisation
Strong Python and PyTorch / Hugging Face Transformers experience
A project that trains or evaluates a model on real text — not only an API wrapper
Curiosity about linguistics, failure modes and evaluation design

roles.title: Computer Vision Engineer
roles.description: Cameras are everywhere: number-plate readers, defect inspection on factory lines, medical imaging, crop monitoring. You build models that turn pixels into decisions, then make them run fast enough on edge hardware.
responsibilities: Build detection, segmentation, tracking and OCR pipelines (YOLO-family, SAM, OpenCV)
Curate and label datasets, and design augmentation strategies for scarce real-world data
Optimise inference for edge devices through quantisation, TensorRT, ONNX and Jetson
Deploy vision services against latency budgets measured in milliseconds
Measure real-world accuracy: drift, edge cases and false positives that actually matter
qualifications: B.Tech / M.Tech with strong linear algebra, geometry and probability
Python plus PyTorch; C++ is useful for edge deployment
A project built on real images — drone, webcam, medical or industrial data
Patience for data cleaning, which is most of the job

roles.title: MLOps & ML Platform Engineer
roles.description: Most models never reach production, and the ones that do decay quietly. You own the pipeline that trains, versions, deploys and monitors them — the difference between a notebook and a product.
responsibilities: Build reproducible training pipelines with experiment tracking and model registries (MLflow, DVC)
Package and serve models behind APIs with autoscaling, canary releases and rollback
Monitor production models for data drift, concept drift and silent degradation
Automate retraining triggers and CI/CD for data and models, not only for code
Manage GPU cost, feature stores and the shared infrastructure data scientists depend on
qualifications: B.Tech CSE with solid software engineering, not only modelling
Docker and Kubernetes confidence; Python for tooling
Understanding of the ML lifecycle from data collection to drift
On-call temperament: you debug production, not only notebooks

roles.title: DevOps & Release Engineer
roles.description: The person who turns "it works on my machine" into "it ships twenty times a day". You own build pipelines, deployment automation, environment parity and the release process every other team depends on.
responsibilities: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines: build, test, scan, deploy and roll back automatically
Automate infrastructure with Terraform or Ansible and keep environments reproducible
Containerise services and manage orchestrator workloads (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS)
Instrument release health with deploy metrics, error budgets, alerting and runbooks
Cut lead time and toil through scripting, caching and developer-experience tooling
qualifications: B.Tech CSE / IT with strong Linux and scripting fundamentals
Comfort with Git workflows, branching strategies and code review
Hands-on Docker experience; Kubernetes exposure
An automation mindset — if you did it twice, script it

roles.title: Database Engineer (DBA)
roles.description: Applications are easy to write and hard to keep fast at scale. You design schemas, tune the queries that page you at 3 a.m., plan backups and failovers, and decide when a table has outgrown its database.
responsibilities: Design schemas, indexes and partitions for transactional and analytical workloads
Tune slow queries using EXPLAIN plans, statistics and connection-pool configuration
Own backups, point-in-time recovery, replication and failover drills
Plan migrations and zero-downtime schema changes with application teams
Capacity-plan storage, IOPS and cost as data volume grows
qualifications: B.Tech CSE / MCA with strong SQL and storage fundamentals
Understanding of B-trees, transactions and isolation levels
Hands-on with at least one of PostgreSQL, MySQL or MongoDB
Calm, methodical incident handling

roles.title: Network & NOC Engineer
roles.description: Every office, data centre and cloud region is a network somebody has to design and defend. You route packets, segment traffic, run the monitoring that catches outages, and make connectivity boring again.
responsibilities: Configure and troubleshoot routing, switching and VLAN segmentation (Cisco / Juniper / Aruba)
Operate firewalls, VPNs, load balancers and zero-trust access policies
Monitor links and latency, and respond to NOC alerts before users notice
Plan capacity and design connectivity between offices, data centres and cloud VPCs
Document the topology and keep it true after every change
qualifications: B.Tech ECE / CSE or B.Sc IT with networking fundamentals
Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, subnets and the OSI layers
CCNA-level knowledge; certification is a strong plus for NOC roles
Methodical packet-level debugging with Wireshark and traceroute

roles.title: Application Security Engineer (AppSec)
roles.description: Instead of chasing breaches after they happen, you build the guardrails that prevent them. You threat-model designs, review code, wire scanners into CI, and teach developers to fix whole classes of bug rather than single instances.
responsibilities: Threat-model new features and review pull requests for injection, auth and access-control flaws
Run SAST/DAST/dependency scanning in CI and triage findings without drowning developers in noise
Harden authentication, session management, secrets handling and API authorisation
Lead secure code review and give developers fixes they can actually apply
Support incident response with root-cause analysis and preventive controls
qualifications: B.Tech CSE with genuine interest in how web applications break
Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and modern web stacks
Ability to read code deeply in at least one language (Java, Python, JS/TS)
Diplomatic communication — security work is mostly persuasion

must_have: One language in depth (Java / Python / JS)

roles.title: Penetration Tester (Red Team)
roles.description: You are paid to break in before somebody else does. Red-team engagements, network and web exploitation, phishing simulations and privilege escalation — followed by a report that makes remediation actually possible.
responsibilities: Plan and execute authorised penetration tests against web apps, networks, APIs and infrastructure
Chain vulnerabilities into real attack paths and escalate privileges without being detected
Run social-engineering and phishing simulations with measured click rates
Write clear reports: finding, evidence, business impact and a specific remediation
Support purple-team exercises and re-test fixes to confirm they hold
qualifications: B.Tech CSE or B.Sc with strong systems and networking fundamentals
Linux fluency, scripting in Python or Bash, and real lab practice (HTB, TryHackMe, VAPT labs)
eJPT / OSCP-track certification strongly preferred by employers
Strict professional ethics and disciplined scoping

roles.title: Product Designer (UX / UI)
roles.description: Design is the difference between a feature users finish and one they abandon. You research the problem, map the flow, design the interface, prototype it, and hand engineering something unambiguous.
responsibilities: Run user interviews, usability tests and heuristic reviews, and turn them into design problems
Map user flows, information architecture and edge-case states before reaching for visuals
Design wireframes, high-fidelity UI and interactive prototypes in Figma
Maintain and evolve the design system, components and accessibility standards
Pair with engineers through implementation and verify the shipped result against the design
qualifications: Degree in design or HCI — or any field plus a portfolio that shows your thinking
Figma fluency and a grasp of layout, typography, colour and spacing systems
Evidence of research, iteration and trade-offs, not only polished screens
Ability to explain and defend decisions with user evidence

roles.title: Technical Program Manager (TPM)
roles.description: Big programmes fail at the seams between teams. You run the plan across engineering, product, data and vendors — surfacing risks early, killing ambiguity, and keeping twenty people pointed at the same outcome.
responsibilities: Own delivery plans: milestones, dependencies, risks and trade-offs across multiple teams
Run planning, standups and retrospectives that produce decisions rather than status theatre
Translate between engineering constraints and business expectations in both directions
Track delivery metrics and flag slippage while there is still time to react
Coordinate releases, vendor delivery, compliance gates and cross-team launch readiness
qualifications: B.Tech plus an MBA, or a technical degree with strong delivery exposure
Understanding of software delivery: CI/CD, sprints, estimation and technical debt
Excellent written communication and meeting facilitation
A bias for unblocking others over owning work yourself
